instruction: Ten shining swords hang point-down in the night sky inside the arched window: one at the top, four pairs below it, and one single sword at the very bottom centre of the arrangement. Remove exactly ONE sword: the single one at the bottom centre, lowest in the sky, and paint starry sky in its place. Do not change or move the other nine: the one at the top and the four pairs. The finished painting shows exactly nine swords.
